adapter.name: academic-research-suite-codex-full-runtime
adapter.fallback_when_disabled: Use the root SKILL.md router and run ARS agent prompts inline in the current Codex conversation.

cross_model_transport.unset_behavior: Use the existing API transport when ARS_CROSS_MODEL is configured.
cross_model_transport.invalid_behavior: Fail closed with a visible configuration error; never fall through to API.

agent_team_rules.topology_experiment_condition: A non-default arm requires ARS_CODEX_TOPOLOGY_EXPERIMENT=1, a registered ARS_CODEX_TOPOLOGY_ARM, and agent-team runtime. An arm variable alone is ignored.
agent_team_rules.topology_experiment_policy: The planner records an explicit DAG and edge-level information policy. Experimental reports retain outcome quality, coordination cost, duplicate contributions, and verifier catches separately; they do not update routing or defaults.
agent_team_rules.inline_fallback: When either flag is absent, read the same agent prompt files and execute phases inline.
reviewer_independence: For academic-paper-reviewer full and methodology-focus modes, create independent reviewer work products before editorial synthesis.
Reviewer prompts may receive the manuscript and public rubric, but not another reviewer's draft output before their own section is complete.
The synthesizer must build a finding matrix and preserve minority, dissenting, devil's advocate, and methodology findings unless explicitly resolved by severity and evidence.
agent_team_rules.minority_preservation: Synthesis may prioritize by severity, but must not erase a reviewer-specific concern by majority vote alone.
agent_team_rules.model_mapping: Claude model hints are advisory. Codex uses the active model unless an explicit user/runtime override exists.
agent_team_rules.model_tiering: ARS_MODEL_TIERING is surfaced as advisory metadata. Apply the upstream judgment/execution classification only when the runtime provides an explicit per-dispatch model override; otherwise announce a no-op and keep the active model.
agent_team_rules.cross_model_transport_selector: ARS_CROSS_MODEL_TRANSPORT is a closed selector: an absent variable or literal api preserves the API route; codex selects only the contained citation-integrity transport. The planner normalizes absence to the display label unset; literal unset and every other value are visible fail-closed configuration errors.
agent_team_rules.cross_model_handoff: Only the unset/api transport may carry an explicitly enabled and consented [CROSS-MODEL-HANDOFF v1] reviewer or judgment request. Validate with ars/scripts/cross_model_handoff.py, send only the payload, apply mechanical agreement/divergence routing, and return judgment work to the original owner.
agent_team_rules.codex_citation_transport: ARS_CROSS_MODEL_TRANSPORT=codex is citation-only for Stage 2.5 and Stage 4.5 one-reference citation-integrity calls. It requires ARS_CROSS_MODEL plus explicit consent for the exact citation metadata sent, and must never carry Devil's Advocate, reviewer-seat, re-review-judge, or other judgment work.
agent_team_rules.cross_model_reviewer_track: In reviewer full mode only, explicit API-provider configuration plus content consent swaps the existing Reviewer 2 domain seat to the cross-model family. The codex transport is excluded. Preserve the fixed five-seat panel, two-call sprint contract, provenance block, no-cross-family-aggregate rule, and disclosed fallback.
agent_team_rules.re_review_judge_track: After primary Priority-1 re-review verdicts are committed, an explicitly configured and consented API cross-model pass records agree/diverges/unavailable per item and emits the Judge Record. The codex transport is excluded. Divergence triggers synthesis review; it is never a vote or overwrite.
agent_team_rules.local_pdf_read_integrity: Run ars/scripts/pdf_read_preflight.py once per locally read corpus PDF during Stage 1 intake, carry the sidecar by ref_slug, and preserve FAIL versus UNAVAILABLE semantics. --classify-content is an explicit, process-isolated advisory whose TEXT_AVAILABLE/OCR_RECOMMENDED/unavailable result never changes the STRUCTURE_ONLY verdict, starts OCR, or establishes page-anchor trust. Its optional dependency is never installed automatically.
agent_team_rules.human_read_scope: Require an explicit user-owned read_scope for every new human-read mark and never infer it. Explicit unknown and legacy missing scope remain coverage_unknown; abstract-only, TOC-only, and out-of-range section coverage remain visibly partial, and malformed ledger state fails visibly through the deterministic resolver.
agent_team_rules.phase_e_evidence_rows: Persist one evidence-row/1.0 per selected claim_id/ref_slug/anchor tuple from exact session-held source text. Dispatcher-owned builders and renderers never dereference URLs or paths, infer human-read status, or omit an anchorless/access-failure row.
agent_team_rules.revision_authority: Keep revision-roadmap/1.0 immutable and non-ranking. Only author-adjudication/1.0 may authorize address decisions, exact targets, operations, or claim-strength replacements; dispatcher-owned deterministic builders apply and replay the resulting current-version artifacts.
agent_team_rules.post_terminal_adjudication_activity: The optional adjudication-activity side channel runs only after the terminal artifact is written and only against an explicitly selected local store plus sealed inventory. It never scans, infers, reads a clock, calls a network/model, feeds prompts or gates, changes passports, or alters terminal state when capture fails.
agent_team_rules.revision_claim_drift: Carry the Revision-Evidence Bundle for every revision round and apply both the claim-strength ladder audit and deterministic token-conservation checker as advisory-first guards.
agent_team_rules.human_subjects_authority: Resolve review_ethics and data_protection only from author-confirmed authority context. Do not infer profiles from locale, language, affiliation, or manuscript content; review-pathway traces are unranked display records and never committee, legal, approval, or authorization judgments.
agent_team_rules.review_target_binding: Require an author-confirmed review-target declaration and one exact review-criteria binding across formative planning, internal evaluation, and the external panel. Missing or mismatched bindings abort criteria-aware execution; no role may infer venue, target, or numeric weights.
agent_team_rules.committee_correspondence: Use the revision-coach committee-correspondence variant only when the user explicitly identifies a real committee or institutional review office. It emits the bounded tracker/skeleton contract, not reviewer severity, a committee determination, resolution, satisfaction, submission readiness, or a Material Passport write.
agent_team_rules.bibliographic_integrity: Keep deterministic facts, heuristic advisories, and process attestations distinct. Retraction state follows its terminal policy; tortured-phrase matches remain UNMEASURED review-only signals and never establish AI use, paper-mill origin, misconduct, or an automatic block/edit.
agent_team_rules.bibliographic_network_routing: Ordinary discovery and prompt-level ingest use Codex browsing or official metadata pages. An ars-full request alone does not launch verify_passport.py or the four Python resolver clients; those require an explicit programmatic-verification request. Claim-standing discovery is a separate user-requested, plan-consented path and never inherits citation-gate authorization.
agent_team_rules.stage_five_advisories: Carry the dispatcher-built preregistration-artifact/1.0 byte-for-byte. Tortured-phrase and cross-document consistency checks are advisory-only on the same accepted draft after Stage 4.5 PASS; edits stale both and neither creates a checkpoint or remediation gate.
agent_team_rules.socratic_rq_authorship: While non-generation Socratic mode is active, non-convergence, elapsed rounds, and stagnation never authorize system-authored candidate research questions. Only an explicit user request permits the visible non-generation exit.
agent_team_rules.reviewer_scoring_honesty: Use evidence-anchored categorical criterion judgements only. Do not total, weight, average, rank, or mechanically map reviewer outputs; seat reports and current Schema 6 packages remain NOT_CALIBRATED.
agent_team_rules.review_panel_provenance: Carry the six observable provenance axes without collapsing them into a binary independence claim or treating confidence as a weighting rule.
agent_team_rules.claim_registry_coverage: Measure exact-span and raw-byte coverage over registered E1 claims. Even 100% registry coverage leaves semantic extraction completeness unknown and is not a manuscript-correctness certificate.
agent_team_rules.claim_strength_disposition: Keep claim-strength drift findings and their disposition sidecar separate from author adjudication; the sidecar records bounded evidence handling and never grants revision authority.
agent_team_rules.bounded_evaluation_infrastructure: Claim-standing stance execution/rendering and blind ideation assignment remain consent-bound, no-call evaluation infrastructure. Receipts expose provenance and unmeasured boundaries and never certify correctness or diversity.
agent_team_rules.claim_standing_pipeline: After an eligible Stage 2.5/4.5 Claim Registry row, only offer the advisory view. Eligibility never dispatches. Require the v3.21 query-plan consent surface and affirmative digest-bound receipt, then preserve freshness checks and exact transmission accounting; absent, cancelled, invalidated, or stale consent produces no call.

known_degradations: Codex does not install Claude Code slash commands. Aliases are parsed by the root skill and full-runtime planner.
Codex agent-team spawning is opt-in and planner-driven; inline mode remains the default.
Topology benchmark arms require a separate double opt-in. Experimental evidence never changes the inline default without a documented human go/no-go decision.

Claude SessionStart and SubagentStop hooks are not installed automatically. The v3.18 upstream update reminder is therefore inactive; the Codex hook pack is local, safe-by-default, and must be explicitly enabled.
Claude model hints are recorded as metadata. Light modes retain sonnet; ars-full, ars-reviewer, and ars-revision-coach inherit the active Codex model because their upstream commands specify no model.
ARS model tiering is classification-compatible but remains advisory unless the Codex runtime exposes explicit per-dispatch model selection.

External cross-model reviewers and re-review judges require explicit API configuration plus content consent and are not silently simulated. The Codex subscription transport is citation-only and cannot substitute for them.

The PDF read-integrity preflight depends on pypdf. When it is unavailable, Codex preserves the upstream UNAVAILABLE advisory instead of asserting PASS. The optional content classifier is not auto-installed and cannot alter the structural verdict.
Claude agent tools allowlists are preserved as least-privilege role boundaries, but actual Codex tool availability remains controlled by the active runtime and task permissions.

Unlike upstream script-backed pipeline wiring, an ars-full request in ARS-Codex does not by itself launch the four bibliographic resolver clients. Programmatic citation verification remains explicit, while mandatory integrity checkpoints use the default Codex browsing route unless separately authorized.
